caption: The drawing is composed of five distinct objects illustrated in black ink on a beige background. In the upper left corner is a circular decorative plate with ornate floral and leafy patterns filling the wide border and the center, where the initials "MC" appear prominently. Below the plate is a horizontal band with repeating patterns, possibly an architectural detail. To the upper right is a tall, slender vase with a fluted top and horizontal banding, featuring a stylized animal motif on its side. To the lower right of the vase is a small oval object with a sculpted face in relief, possibly a medallion or decorative knob. In the lower right corner is a heraldic shield, surrounded by elaborate leaf and floral scrollwork, with a bird perched on branches depicted on the shield itself. The artist's signature, "Lawrence Flynn," is located beneath the shield. The overall composition is detailed with intricate lines and patterns, utilizing only black ink for all outlines and shading.
title: Silver Tankard
